This application can be used with different devices. Individual modules may depend on the connected hardware.
After programming the device (individual address + application), you can synchronize the configuration with the hardware capabilities:

ETS tip
To apply the same settings to multiple channels, hold Ctrl and select the corresponding pages with the mouse.
The selected settings are then applied to all selected channels.
